w: A young American doctor, Teddy Aves, informed Swamishri, "I feel the tremendous pressure of work." Swamishri blessed him saying, "There is no need to bear the pressure of work. Believe God as the Doer. If you believe that you are the doer of work and because of you it is done, then you will feel the burden of work. But if you believe God as the Doer you will feel lighter."

Swamishri blessed some balaks who had come from Bhavnagar, saying, "Study properly. Attend the Bal Mandal. And obey your parents." The three fundamentals prescribed by Swamishri are beacons for all children to excel and progress in mundane and spiritual things.
Swamishri sanctified an ambulance donated by Dr. Sudhirbhai Patel (Bryan, USA) for the hospital in Dabhoi.

An assembly for the inauguration of a 2,000 litre water tank constructed by BAPS for Mahelav village was held in the mandir hall. Shri Narottambhai Patel, Minister for Water and Supplies, addressed the assembly. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly. At 9.00 a.m., Swamishri and Shri Narottambhai inaugurated amidst Vedic chantings 'Yagnapurush Varigruh'. Thereafter, Shri Narottambhai unveiled the plaque declaring the village square as 'Pramukh Swami Maharaj Chowk' and the main approach road into the village as 'Shastriji Maharaj Marg'.

In the morning the former Deputy Prime Minister of India Shri Lalkrishna Advani met Swamishri and received his blessings. Thereafter Shri L.M.Singhvi, former ambassador of India to the UK, met Swamishri.

At 6.30 pm an assembly of dignitaries was held in the mandir hall. Swamishri blessed the congregation, “No matter what one’s faith be the teachings of the scriptures and great saints have always been about the attainment of moksha. If one follows them then one is a human being. An animal has no discrimination as to where to sit, how to raise its offsprings; whereas man has been endowed with the power of discrimination. To become an ideal man the Shikshapatri has given 212 aphorisms…”
